```python
import openpyxl

INPUT_FILE = "ssb_269_43_init.xlsx"
OUTPUT_FILE = "output.xlsx"
SHEET_NAME = "Sheet1"
COL_H = 8  # column H
COL_I = 9  # column I


def is_blank(value):
    """A cell is considered blank if it is None or an empty/whitespace-only string."""
    if value is None:
        return True
    if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() == "":
        return True
    return False


def main():
    # Load the workbook, keeping formulas and all existing sheets intact
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_FILE)

    if SHEET_NAME not in wb.sheetnames:
        raise ValueError(f"Sheet '{SHEET_NAME}' not found in workbook")

    ws = wb[SHEET_NAME]

    # Iterate from the bottom row upward so deleting rows doesn't shift
    # the indices of rows we haven't checked yet.
    for row_idx in range(ws.max_row, 0, -1):
        value_i = ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=COL_I).value
        value_h = ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=COL_H).value

        # Delete the row if column I has a value but column H is blank
        if not is_blank(value_i) and is_blank(value_h):
            ws.delete_rows(row_idx)

    # Save the result as output.xlsx (all other sheets/data preserved)
    wb.save(OUTPUT_FILE)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
